title: Rate gate synchronizer and soft-failover escort for regional SLO cohesion
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: during cross-region incidents we saw rapid, oscillating circuit flips and tenant-level SLO breaches when regional probes and rate-limiters disagreed. This PR introduces a lightweight synchronizer for per-region rate gates and a soft-failover escort that coordinates ephemeral circuit transitions to reduce oscillation and provide predictable SLO relaxation. Key changes: 1) services/ingress: introduce RateGateSynchronizer that periodically reconciles local token-bucket state with region-wide lease metadata; 2) pkg/failover: add SoftFailoverEscort which sequences circuit transitions with an exponential dampening window and transparent handoff to a fallback pool; 3) control plane: add lease metadata endpoint and a compact lease serializer for low-overhead heartbeats; 4) charts/values: expose new toggles for rollout (synchronizer.enabled and escort.stabilization_ms); 5) e2e tests: add deterministic chaos test that simulates regional probe jitter and validates no more than one reopen per 30s per-tenant; 6) observability: new metrics (rategate_synced, escort_transitions, escort_backoff_seconds) and dashboards. Backwards compatibility: feature is gated behind flags; default off for Private installs. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-4821; - [x] unit tests for synchronizer logic; - [x] e2e chaos test added; - [x] metrics emitted and dashboards updated; - [x] staged rollout plan in PR description. Testing and verification: local unit tests, CI integration tests (one flaky e2e rerun), manual canary deployment across two test regions with traffic replay and observer-confirmed reduced reopen rate (~70% reduction in short-term reopen flaps). Rollout plan: feature flag ON for canary tenant subset -> monitor escort_transitions & regional SLOs for 48 hours -> progressively widen. Rollback: toggle flags off; synchronizer is non-blocking and falls back to current per-node token buckets if lease endpoint unavailable. Related work: follow-ups to ENG-4209 (circuit observability) and SRE-120 (regional failover playbooks).
